## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A five-fascicle late-Míng sub-commentary by **Yúnqī Zhūhóng** 雲棲袾宏 ([袾宏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%A2%BE%E5%AE%8F), 1535–1615) on [智顗](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E9%A1%97) Zhìyǐ–[灌頂](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%81%8C%E9%A0%82) Guàndǐng's *Fànwǎng púsàjièjīng yìshū* ([KR6k0084](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0084)). 發隱 *fāyǐn* "bringing forth the hidden" expresses the genre — a sub-commentary that draws out the deeper meanings of the parent commentary.

**Abstract**

Zhūhóng's commentary is one of the foundational documents of the **late-Míng Vinaya revival**, in which Zhūhóng — together with [憨山德清](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%86%A8%E5%B1%B1%E5%BE%B7%E6%B8%85) Hānshān Déqīng (1546–1623) and [智旭](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E6%97%AD) Ǒuyì Zhìxù 蕅益智旭 — sought to recover practical Vinaya scholarship after the long Míng decline of monastic discipline. Zhūhóng's emphasis on the *Fànwǎng* bodhisattva-precepts as the foundation of *both* monastic and lay Buddhist ethics shaped the late-Míng synthesis of Pure Land devotion, Chán meditation, and bodhisattva-discipline. Together with the auxiliary texts [KR6k0087](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0087) (*shìyì*) and [KR6k0088](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0088) (*wènbiàn*), this work constitutes Zhūhóng's complete *Fànwǎng* commentary.
